audience: teams that send SMS alerts, reminders or call notices from Twilio numbers

useCases.title: Check why SMS messages failed
useCases.text: List recent SMS, MMS and WhatsApp messages and open one to read its status and error code. Count the messages that failed this week.

useCases.title: Review calls and recordings
useCases.text: List voice calls by number, status or start date. Open one call to read its duration and price, and list the recordings made on the account.

useCases.title: Check usage and cost by category
useCases.text: Read the billed usage and cost for a period, by category such as outbound SMS or calls. Read the prepaid balance of the account.

useCases.title: Send one SMS from your number
useCases.text: Send one SMS or MMS from a number you own. The message costs money and reaches a real person, so confirm the text before you send it.

useCases.title: End a live call
useCases.text: End a call that is in progress or ringing. The caller and the callee are disconnected, and the call cannot be restored.
